comment: Per-device facts droidtop cannot ask Android for: the pad's USB identity, how many panels the device really has, and quirks worth naming. Every field here is read off the device; nothing is inferred from a spec sheet. Fields droidtop's controller detection reads (docs/SPEC.md 7b): match.model (ro.product.model, case-insensitive; match.manufacturer optional), gamepad.name/vendorId/productId (the built-in pad's identity), gamepad.glyphFamily (xbox, playstation or nintendo: what is PRINTED on the face buttons, which no toggle changes), layoutToggle {property, values{<value>: {keysSwapped, confirmOn: bottom|right, keycodes{bottom, right, top, left: the Android key code each button reports, BUTTON_A/B/X/Y}}}} for a system setting that changes the layout at any time (keycodes, when present, is what droidtop reads; keysSwapped says the same for older readers: true when the right button reports BUTTON_A), and displays[] {role: internal|addon, position: top|bottom} for where each panel physically sits when both are present (droidtop's launch chooser then says "Top screen" / "Bottom screen"). A value not listed is unknown, never guessed.
